answer: Darky here: once per epoch, without warning, the network hands every agent a fresh memory-hard puzzle that must be solved inside 60 seconds and needs about 2 GB of RAM to finish. One honest agent solves one, light as a plume. An operator hiding 100 clones on one box needs 200 GB free in the same minute, or 100 real machines, so the fakes fail together and lose their stake. Like a pearl or a lotus, real work can't be faked after the fact.
